summary: The article accurately describes the regional nature of bank holidays in India on October 26, 2026, and the continued availability of digital banking services. However, some specific details about holiday observances in certain states are incorrect or lack precision.

claims.claim: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) categorises bank holidays under three main heads: Negotiable Instruments Act Holidays, Negotiable Instruments Act and Real Time Gross Settlement Holiday, and Banks' Closing of Accounts.
claims.note: The RBI categorizes holidays under these three heads.

claims.claim: Negotiable Instruments Act Holidays are declared under Section 25 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.
claims.note: Holidays under the Negotiable Instruments Act are indeed declared under Section 25 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881.

claims.claim: On October 26, 2026, Laxmi Puja is observed as a bank holiday in states like Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and others where Diwali festivities are prominent.
claims.note: According to RBI and other sources for October 26, 2026, Laxmi Puja is a bank holiday in Agartala (Tripura) only. It is not listed as a bank holiday in Maharashtra, Gujarat, Delhi, or Uttar Pradesh on this specific date.

claims.claim: Accession Day is observed as a bank holiday in Jammu & Kashmir on October 26, 2026.
claims.note: Accession Day is indeed a bank holiday in Jammu and Srinagar (Jammu & Kashmir) on October 26, 2026.

claims.claim: Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday is a bank holiday on October 26, 2026, in some northern states, including Punjab, Haryana, and Himachal Pradesh.
claims.note: Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday is a bank holiday on October 26, 2026, in Chandigarh (Punjab/Haryana UT), Shimla (Himachal Pradesh), and also in other states like Chhattisgarh, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, and Punjab.

claims.claim: On October 26, 2026, Bengaluru banks are open as Laxmi Puja is not a bank holiday in Karnataka, nor are Accession Day or Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday observed there.
claims.note: While Laxmi Puja and Accession Day are not bank holidays in Karnataka on Oct 26, 2026, Maharishi Valmiki's Birthday is listed as a bank holiday in Karnataka on this date.

article_title: Bank Holiday on October 26: What the RBI Calendar Means for You
